common.tagline: All your medical appointments and exams in one place.

footer.privacy: Your health data is encrypted and handled in line with the LGPD.

landing.heroSubtitle: Book doctors and exams, see everything on one calendar and take it to Google Calendar.
landing.bookText: Pick the specialty or exam, the clinic and the best time.
landing.calendarText: View by month, week or list and export to Google Calendar.
landing.secureText: Encrypted data and optional two-factor verification.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.placeholder: Your upcoming appointments will show up here.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Access your account to see your appointments.

mfa.title: Two-factor verification
mfa.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.recoveryDescription: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works only once.

register.title: Create account
register.cpfHint: Digits only or in the 000.000.000-00 format.
register.consentText: Your personal and health data is stored encrypted and used only to manage your appointments. You can export or delete your data at any time.
register.consentLabel: I have read and agree to the processing of my personal data.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a link to reset your password.
forgot.sent: If the email is registered, you will receive a link shortly.

reset.title: New password
reset.success: Password reset. Sign in with your new password.
reset.missingToken: The link is incomplete. Request a new reset link.

verify.title: Email verification
verify.success: Email verified. You can now sign in.
verify.checkInbox: We sent a confirmation link to your email. Open it to activate your account.
verify.resent: If the email is registered, we sent a new confirmation.

validation.codeFormat: Enter the 6 digits of the code.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some data is invalid. Please check and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We could not find what you were looking for.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The submitted content is too large.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again shortly.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.CSRF_INVALID: The request could not be validated. Reload the page and try again.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Please verify your email before signing in.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: The password must have at least 10 characters and must not be too common.
errors.CONSENT_REQUIRED: You must accept the consent notice (LGPD).
errors.MFA_NOT_SETUP: Two-factor authentication has not been set up yet.
errors.SLOT_ALREADY_BOOKED: This slot was just booked. Please choose another.
errors.USER_TIME_CONFLICT: You already have an appointment at this time.
errors.CANCELLATION_WINDOW_CLOSED: Cancellation is only possible up to 2 hours before the start.
errors.APPOINTMENT_NOT_SCHEDULED: This appointment is no longer active.
errors.DATE_RANGE_TOO_LARGE: The selected date range is too large.
errors.IN_USE: This item is in use and cannot be removed.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
